categories.TEXT_INK_CANDIDATE: Persisted descendant word glyph support, excluding pixels also referenced by musical glyphs. Not confirmed text ownership.
categories.MUSIC_INK_CANDIDATE: Persisted musical Inter glyph support, excluding text-glyph support. Not original-source edit authorization.
categories.UNCLASSIFIED: Neither support set; includes background, antialiasing and unrecognized content. Never infer permission from absence.

independent_confirmed_text: UNKNOWN until two independent source-only readers and adjudication; never zero by absence
threshold: No threshold for classification; grayscale <127 is descriptive only, not admission
prediction_intersections: Replay only frozen GT06 component masks; require byte-exact union with frozen alpha PNG and exact reproduction of stored protected intersection counts. Never change predictions or protection.
human_packet: All requested parent/descendant source crops; no predictions, OCR text, support masks or coordinator classifications. Original resolution, opaque case IDs, UNKNOWN/MIXED options, separate immutable A/B submissions and separate adjudication after both freezes.
authorization: NONE; all existing protections remain active; no source erasure or composite
